blocks.prompt: 5. Resolve into partial fractions: \(\frac{6x^3 + 5x^2 - 7}{2x^2 - x - 1}\) [printed as \(5x2\) in the numerator]
blocks.explanation:
The top has degree 3 and the bottom degree 2: improper.
We must divide first, then split the remainder over \((x - 1)(2x + 1)\) (Case I).
Plan: long division, factorise, identity, find \(A\), \(B\), check.
steps:
Given: \(\frac{6x^3 + 5x^2 - 7}{2x^2 - x - 1}\) (the book prints \(5x2\); it means \(5x^2\))
To find: its partial fractions.
Method: Improper fraction, so: fraction = quotient + remainder/denominator. Then resolve the proper part by Case I.

Long division
\[6x^3 \div 2x^2 = 3x\]
\[3x(2x^2 - x - 1) = 6x^3 - 3x^2 - 3x\]
Subtract: \(8x^2 + 3x - 7\)
\[8x^2 \div 2x^2 = 4\]
\[4(2x^2 - x - 1) = 8x^2 - 4x - 4\]
Subtract: \(7x - 3\)
Why: Divide the leading terms, multiply back, subtract, and repeat until the remainder's degree (1) is less than the divisor's (2).

Write the result of the division
\[= 3x + 4 + \dfrac{7x - 3}{2x^2 - x - 1}\]
Why: Quotient \(3x + 4\), remainder \(7x - 3\).

Factorise the denominator
\[2x^2 - x - 1 = 2x^2 - 2x + x - 1\]
\[= (x - 1)(2x + 1)\]
Why: Split the middle term: product \(2 \times (-1) = -2\), sum \(-1\), so \(-2x + x\).

Write the form and the identity
\[\dfrac{7x - 3}{(x - 1)(2x + 1)} = \dfrac{A}{x - 1} + \dfrac{B}{2x + 1}\]
\[7x - 3 = A(2x + 1) + B(x - 1) \quad (i)\]
Why: Two different linear factors; multiply by \((x - 1)(2x + 1)\) to clear the fractions.

Find \(A\): put \(x = 1\) in (i)
\[7 - 3 = A(3)\]
\[A = \tfrac{4}{3}\]
Why: \(x - 1 = 0\), so the \(B\) term vanishes.

Find \(B\): put \(x = -\tfrac{1}{2}\) in (i)
\[-\tfrac{7}{2} - 3 = B\left(-\tfrac{3}{2}\right)\]
\[-\tfrac{13}{2} = -\tfrac{3}{2}B\]
\[B = \tfrac{13}{3}\]
Why: \(2x + 1 = 0\) gives \(x = -\tfrac{1}{2}\); then the \(A\) term vanishes.

Compare coefficients
\[x:\ 2A + B = \tfrac{8}{3} + \tfrac{13}{3} = 7 \;\checkmark\]
\[\text{const}:\ A - B = \tfrac{4}{3} - \tfrac{13}{3} = -3 \;\checkmark\]
Why: Expanding (i) gives \((2A + B)x + (A - B)\), which must equal \(7x - 3\).

Write the answer
\[= 3x + 4 + \dfrac{4}{3(x - 1)} + \dfrac{13}{3(2x + 1)}\]
Why: Quotient plus the partial fractions of the remainder.

Check: recombine the fractions
\[\dfrac{4}{3(x - 1)} + \dfrac{13}{3(2x + 1)}\]
\[= \dfrac{4(2x + 1) + 13(x - 1)}{3(x - 1)(2x + 1)}\]
\[= \dfrac{21x - 9}{3(2x^2 - x - 1)} = \dfrac{7x - 3}{2x^2 - x - 1}\]
Then \((3x + 4)(2x^2 - x - 1) + 7x - 3\)
\[= 6x^3 + 5x^2 - 7x - 4 + 7x - 3\]
\[= 6x^3 + 5x^2 - 7 \;\checkmark\]
Why: Quotient times divisor plus remainder must give back the numerator.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The question prints the numerator as \(6x^3 + 5x2 - 7\): the power 2 has dropped to the line. It is \(6x^3 + 5x^2 - 7\), as the answer key \(3x + 4 + \frac{4}{3(x - 1)} + \frac{13}{3(2x + 1)}\) confirms.
